skill_name: Generate a unique diet plan that can help a 14 year old adolescent lose 5 pounds.
workflow: A balanced diet plan for a 14 year old adolescent to lose 5 pounds would include three meals and two snacks daily with a focus on nutrient-dense, low-calorie foods, like vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and lean proteins. Meals should also include healthy fats, such as nuts, avocados, and olive oil. For breakfast, try a whole-grain cereal with almond milk, sliced banana, and walnuts.
